bugs.title: Sales reporting lacks custom date, cashier and payment-method filters
steps: Sign in to the production Nexstock QA Company.
Inspect Reporting Horizon, branch controls and available filters.
bugs.expected: Sales reporting supports custom start/end dates, cashier and payment-method filtering.
bugs.actual: Only preset reporting horizons and branch controls are available. Custom date inputs, cashier and payment-method controls are absent.
bugs.comment: Add the missing dimensions and verify them against non-zero QA sales. Existing branch/preset wiring is not declared broken.

bugs.title: Product sales performance report is unavailable

Inspect Report Focus choices and Business & Sales content.
bugs.expected: A product performance report ranks products by quantity sold and revenue contribution.
bugs.actual: There is no product performance/top-seller report; a revenue trend and stock movement do not provide ranked product revenue.
bugs.comment: Implement the required report and reconcile quantities and revenue with known sales.

bugs.title: Low Stock report omits products beyond the first catalogue page
steps: Sign in to the production Nexstock QA Company.
Paginate the Products catalogue to collect all 71 active products
Identify inventory items at or below reorder point
Open Reports > Low Stock and compare their SKUs.
bugs.expected: Every eligible low-stock/out-of-stock catalogue item appears in the report.
bugs.actual: 53 eligible depleted/critical SKUs are absent. Reporting loads 15 of 71 products. Current cost valuation still reconciles because omitted items have no positive verified stock.
bugs.comment: Load the complete applicable dataset or aggregate server-side. Do not infer an incorrect asset total from zero-stock omissions; later-page positive initialization is separately blocked by P2-COUNT-005.

bugs.title: VAT and fiscal reporting is unavailable
steps: Sign in to the production Nexstock QA Company.
Inspect Report Focus choices and Business & Sales tax content.
bugs.expected: Fiscal reporting distinguishes standard VAT, zero-rated sales and net tax liability.
bugs.actual: Only aggregate tax-collected text exists; no VAT/fiscal report is available.
bugs.comment: Provide the required tax breakdown and reconcile it against eligible transactions. No guessed tax calculation is reported as a bug.
